Firez

Overview

Firez rules the Khadaganian side of Jigran and is the enemy Kir fled. In their confrontation he reveals that he too is a Joon, expelled for necromancy, and claims that his experiments were meant to defeat the Curse. He prolongs his life at Jigran’s expense, tracks Kir with a dragonet and threatens to turn him into an obedient undead servant. His professed concern for the Joons sits beside his enslavement and coercion of them. [1, 2]

Escape from Jigran

Kir, whose full name is Kir-A-Chit-La, is a young Joon enslaved under Firez on Jigran. He escapes the castle, leaving his family behind, and hopes to return with help. Outside the castle, a recruiter mistakes him for someone expected at the camp. Kir conceals his identity and accepts travel papers for work on Suslanger. The apparent opening to freedom instead delivers him to imperial authorities. Hartweik dismisses his papers, treats him as a slave and considers reporting the red-skinned stranger for a reward. [3, 4, 1, 5]

Firez’s identity and the final confrontation

In the throne room, Firez reveals that he too is a Joon and has watched Kir through a dragonet since the escape. He says his people expelled him for necromancy and claims that his rule protected them from the Curse. Kir answers with their enslavement, his parents’ deaths and the destruction of Jigran to prolong Firez’s life. The tyrant’s explanation is his own defence, not proof that the captivity was benevolent. He threatens to kill Kir, raise him as an obedient servant and use him against the baron. Their exchange leads into the final battle for Jigran. [2, 6]
